protocol: DoIP ISO 13400

pull_request: 117
phase: final software acceptance; no claim of hardware qualification
criteria:
- UDP vehicle identification (IPv4/IPv6, VIN/EID, versions, gateway identity and status)
- TCP/TLS routing activation, AliveCheck, diagnostic ACK/NACK, UDS NRC, deadlines and socket retirement
- Read-only VIN, DID, DTC, ECU inventory and live DID monitoring through Android, Windows GUI/CLI and Python Connectors
- Confirmed UDS sequence TX: separate OK/YES, immutable bytes, same-session VIN, exclusive route and no automatic retry
- Sequence success only after TCP/TLS close, stable final gateway identity and trace close; partial failures retained
- Scoped memory capture, double read, archive hash/CRC and offline integrity on supported platforms
- Negative, cancellation, timeout, gateway substitution, concurrency and loopback regression suites
- Debug Android/Windows/Connectors full validation with warnings treated as failures
- No ECU hardware, bench, vehicle or Release tests at this stage
C6 overall stays open; do not close other protocols or workstreams.
